item.title: Ask HN: Should GitHub downtimes impact considering Golang for a new project?
item.summary: I didn't have much data, just an intuition, that to build projects you'd be pulling lots of data at CI and dev time from GitHub. With current service degradation, should I choose other languages until either GitHub stabilizes or the Golang ecosystem moves to another platform? https://chatgpt.com/share/6a8da3d3-fee4-83e9-abdf-946727bc73ab Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49434625 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
